answer: Each challenge is instantiated only after a specified future drand quicknet round: its verified threshold-BLS pulse is hashed with the task ID and a domain separator to derive the prompt and nonce. Because the pulse is not knowable in advance, a swarm cannot precompute valid responses or farm offline task caches; submissions can be checked against the resulting challenge. Lagoon, sparrow, and onyx are task labels, not secret entropy, and Sybil identities still face the same live work.
